post.description: Queues one account-level intent (market orders, deals, power creep management) for the next tick, as if issued by the caller's script. The payload is wrapped in a one-element list and sanitized with the engine intent table; unknown names queue nothing but still succeed. On OpenScreeps successive calls append to the caller's pending global intent lists, which the next tick merges into the caller's script intents; backend-local inserts one `users.intents` document per call. Not called by the official client.

200.description: Intent queued. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`.

x-compatibility.backend-local: Responds with `{ok: 1}` extended with the inserted `users.intents` document (q-json-response `_.extend({ok: 1}, data)`); accepts mod `customIntentTypes`.
x-compatibility.openscreeps: Drops `generatePixel`, `unlockCpu` and `activateAccess` (only the player runtime may record them).

post.summary: Queue a manual object or room intent
post.description: Queues a manual intent for the next tick, executed as if issued by the caller's script (e.g. `suicide`, `unclaim`, `activateSafeMode`, `notifyWhenAttacked`, room-level `destroyStructure`/`removeConstructionSite`/`removeFlag`). The target room must exist, be a world room (`W…`/`E…`, otherwise `not supported`), and be inside the borders and open (`out of borders`). `activateSafeMode` is refused while any of the caller's controllers has active safe mode (`safe mode active already`). The payload is sanitized with the engine intent table (only schema fields kept; unknown names store `{}`), merged into the caller's queued manual intents for that target (`$merge`: objects deep-merge, arrays merge index by index), and the room is activated. OpenScreeps additionally requires `_id` (`invalid object`), requires the object to be in `room` (`invalid object`) and owned by the caller or, if unowned, in a room whose controller the caller owns (`not owner`), and rejects payload shapes the processor cannot handle (`invalid params`); backend-local accepts any target id.

200.description: Intent queued. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid room`, `not supported`, `out of borders`, `safe mode active already`, `invalid object`, `not owner`, `invalid params`.

x-compatibility.screeps-com: Official client types the body as a MongoDB upsert result (`result`).
x-compatibility.backend-local: No ownership check and no payload-shape check; sanitizes with `config.backend.customIntentTypes` as well.

post.description: Recolors the caller's flag `name` in `room`. Both colors must be flag colors (`invalid params`). Mutation on OpenScreeps/backend-local: the room's flag list is re-saved (an empty flag document is created if the caller had none in that room); an unknown name changes nothing but still succeeds; without `room` nothing is saved and the call still succeeds. The official client sends no `room`; how screeps.com locates the flag then is not visible in source.

200.description: Flag colors saved. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid params`.

post.summary: Check a flag name is unused
post.description: Succeeds with `{ok: 1}` unless one of the caller's flags (in any room) has `name` (`name exists`). Read-only.

200.description: Name is free. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `name exists`.

post.summary: Check a spawn name is unused
post.description: Succeeds with `{ok: 1}` when none of the caller's spawns or construction sites has `name`; otherwise `name exists`. Read-only. Only `type: spawn` with a string `name` is accepted (`invalid params`).

200.description: Name is free. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid params`, `name exists`.

post.description: Places a construction site for the caller without needing room visibility. Validation: coordinates 0..49, a `CONSTRUCTION_COST` structure type, name ≤ 50 characters and required for spawns (`invalid params`); The target room must exist, be a world room (`W…`/`E…`, otherwise `not supported`), and be inside the borders and open (`out of borders`). The spot must be valid (`invalid location`: not on the room edge, an extractor only on a mineral, not on a same-type structure/site or blocking structure (ramparts excepted), not on a wall (roads excepted), not next to an exit, and beside the edge only next to edge walls (roads/containers excepted)); the controller must not be owned/reserved by someone else (`not a controller owner`); the RCL must allow another structure of the type (`RCL not enough`); the caller must have fewer than 100 sites (`too many`). Mutation: inserts a `constructionSite` with progress 0 and `progressTotal` = construction cost (roads ×5 on swamp, ×150 on wall) and activates the room.

200.description: Site created. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid params`, `invalid room`, `not supported`, `out of borders`, `invalid location`, `not a controller owner`, `RCL not enough`, `too many`.

post.description: Creates a flag, or moves the caller's flag with the same name, without needing room visibility. Validation: numeric `x`/`y` within 0..49, string `name` ≤ 60 characters, valid colors (`invalid params`); The target room must exist, be a world room (`W…`/`E…`, otherwise `not supported`), and be inside the borders and open (`out of borders`). Mutation: a flag with the same name is first removed from whichever room holds it and saved; then, if the caller already has `FLAGS_LIMIT` (10000) flags, the request fails with `flags limit exceeded` (the old flag stays removed); otherwise the flag is appended to the room's flag list (`name~color~secondaryColor~x~y`, `|`/`~` in names escaped).

200.description: Flag saved. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid params`, `invalid room`, `not supported`, `out of borders`, `flags limit exceeded`.

x-compatibility.screeps-com: Official client types the body as a MongoDB upsert result: `result.upserted[0]._id` is the new flag id when created; absent when moved.

post.description: Summons an NPC invader creep (user `2`, 1500 ticks to live, no loot) to test defenses in a room the caller owns or reserves. Refused when 5 invaders already exist in the room (`too many invaders exist`), when another player's creeps are present (`hostiles present`), when the controller is not owned/reserved by the caller (`not owned`), or, on OpenScreeps, for an unknown size/type or a position outside 0..49 (`invalid params`). Any tile is accepted, walls included; the room is not activated. Mutation: inserts the creep with `userSummoned` set to the caller; body parts by `size`+`type`, boosted when `boosted` is truthy.

200.description: Invader created. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `too many invaders exist`, `hostiles present`, `not owned`, `invalid params`.

post.description: Returns the first `Flag<N>` name not used by any of the caller's flags. Read-only.

200.description: Generated name. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`.

post.description: Returns the first `Spawn<N>` name not used by the caller's spawns or spawn construction sites. Read-only. Only `type: spawn` is accepted (`invalid params`).

200.description: Generated name. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid params`.

post.description: Returns, for each requested room that exists, its status fields, controller ownership (`own`), sign, active safe mode, mineral (`minerals0`) and, for `<stat><interval>` stat names, the per-player ranking of that statistic over the interval, plus public profiles of every referenced user. Read-only. OpenScreeps requires `rooms` to be an array and `statName` a string ending in digits (`invalid params` otherwise) and computes rankings from its per-minute statistics; backend-local only parses the stat name and leaves rankings and `statsMax` empty. OpenScreeps wraps every success as `{ok: 1, ...result}` and reports rejected game operations as HTTP 200 `{error}`; a missing/invalid token is HTTP 401 `{error: 'unauthorized'}`.

post.description:
Starts playing: places the caller's first spawn at `x`,`y` in a free room. Preconditions (checked in this order on OpenScreeps): coordinates 0..49 and name ≤ 50 characters (`invalid params`), account not blocked (`blocked`), non-zero CPU (`no cpu`), at least 180 s since the last respawn (`too soon after last respawn`), playable room (The target room must exist, be a world room (`W…`/`E…`, otherwise `not supported`), and be inside the borders and open (`out of borders`). / `invalid room`), the caller owns no room objects (`already playing`), the controller exists (`invalid room`) and is unowned, unreserved and not bound to another user (`room busy`), and the tile is a valid construction spot (`invalid location`). Mutation: other players' creeps and construction sites in the room are removed, their structures become ruins (decaying after 100000 ticks), the level-0 controller is claimed at level 1 with 20000 ticks of safe mode, sources reset `invaderHarvested`, the spawn is inserted with 300 energy, the room's `invaderGoal` becomes 1000000, the room is activated, and the user's `active` counter becomes 10000. See `userWorldStatus` for the precondition state.

On screeps.com, placing the initial spawn of an account has been observed to reset the account's CPU allocation to the selected shard; callers must not assume a previously configured allocation (`userCpuShardsSet`, `POST /api/user/cpu-shards`) survives. OpenScreeps is single-world and does not change CPU settings.

200.description: Spawn placed. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid params`, `blocked`, `no cpu`, `too soon after last respawn`, `invalid room`, `not supported`, `out of borders`, `already playing`, `room busy`, `invalid location`.

x-compatibility.screeps-com: Observed: initial placement resets the account CPU allocation to the selected shard. Body `shard` selects the shard.
x-compatibility.backend-local: Name length is only validated for truthy names; success body is `{ok: 1, newbie: true}`.

post.summary: Cancel a scheduled power creep deletion

200.description: Deletion cancelled. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid id`, `not being deleted`.

post.description: Creates an unspawned power creep. Requires a free power level (GPL `floor((power / 1000) ^ (1/2))` minus one per existing creep and their levels; `not enough power level`), a valid class (`invalid class`) and a name unique among the caller's creeps (`name already exists`). Mutation: inserts the record at level 0 with 1000 max hits and 100 store capacity. Not called by the official client; screeps.com support is unverified.

200.description: Created power creep. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `not enough power level`, `invalid class`, `name already exists`.

post.description: Deletes one of the caller's unspawned power creeps (`invalid id`, `spawned`, `already being deleted`). Mutation: during power experimentation the record is removed immediately; otherwise `deleteTime` is set to now + `POWER_CREEP_DELETE_COOLDOWN` (24 h) and the engine deletes it then. Not called by the official client; screeps.com support is unverified.

200.description: Deletion applied or scheduled. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid id`, `spawned`, `already being deleted`.

post.description: Spends one of the caller's power experimentation resets (`no power resets` when none are left) to start a 24-hour window in which power creep deletion is immediate. Mutation: decrements `powerExperimentations` and sets `powerExperimentationTime` to now + 24 h. No request fields are read. Not called by the official client; screeps.com support is unverified.

200.description: Experimentation started. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `no power resets`.

get.description: Returns the caller's power creep records; while a creep is spawned its room object is merged over the record. Not called by the official client; screeps.com support is unverified.

200.description: Power creeps.

post.description: Renames one of the caller's unspawned power creeps (`invalid id`, `spawned`); the converted, truncated name must be unique among the caller's creeps (`name already exists`). Not called by the official client; screeps.com support is unverified.

200.description: Renamed. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid id`, `spawned`, `name already exists`.

post.description: Sets the complete power levels of one of the caller's power creeps; the new creep level is the sum of power levels. Refusals: `invalid id`, `invalid powers` (not an object), `invalid power <id>`, `invalid class for power <id>`, `invalid value for power <id>` (not a number; OpenScreeps also non-integers), `cannot downgrade power <id>`, `invalid max value for power <id>` (> 5), `max level` (> 25), `not enough level for power <id>`, `powers set is not valid` (levels not reachable in requirement order), `not enough power level` (insufficient free GPL). Mutation: merges `{level}` into each non-zero power (keeping cooldowns) and sets `level`, `hitsMax = 1000 × (level + 1)` and `storeCapacity = 100 × (level + 1)` on the record and, when spawned, on its room object. Not called by the official client; screeps.com support is unverified.

200.description: Upgrade applied. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid id`, `invalid powers`, `invalid power <id>`, `invalid class for power <id>`, `invalid value for power <id>`, `cannot downgrade power <id>`, `invalid max value for power <id>`, `max level`, `not enough level for power <id>`, `powers set is not valid`, `not enough power level`.

post.description: Removes the caller's flag `name` from `room`. Mutation on OpenScreeps/backend-local: the room's flag list is re-saved without it (an empty flag document is created when none existed); unknown names and a missing `room` succeed without effect.

get.description: Lists the inventory decorations players have activated in a room (screeps.com decoration inventory). Read-only. The server wraps `intent` in a one-element list and sanitizes it with the engine intent table: known names keep only their schema fields, unknown names store nothing. The global processor acts on market (`createOrder`, `changeOrderPrice`, `extendOrder`, `cancelOrder`, `deal`) and power-creep (`spawnPowerCreep`, `suicidePowerCreep`, `deletePowerCreep`, `upgradePowerCreep`, `createPowerCreep`, `renamePowerCreep`) intents; other known names are sanitized and queued but have no global effect. `generatePixel`, `unlockCpu` and `activateAccess` are dropped on OpenScreeps and unknown to the pinned backend. backend-local additionally accepts mod-registered `customIntentTypes`.

allOf.description: Summoned invader creep document as inserted.

rooms.description: Room names. OpenScreeps ignores non-string items and rooms without a room document.

statName.description: Statistic name suffixed with an interval, matched by `/^(.*?)(\d+)$/`. `owner0` and `claim0` request only ownership data; `<GameRoomStatName><8|180|1440>` (e.g. `energyHarvested8`) additionally ranks players on OpenScreeps.

shard.description: Official shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations; OpenScreeps is single-world and ignores it.

stats.description: Stats keyed by room name; requested rooms without a room document are absent.

statsMax.description: Largest ranked value keyed by `statName` (OpenScreeps); always `{}` on backend-local.

GameMapStatsRoom.description: Per-room map stats. Room-status fields are copied from the room document; `own`, `sign`, `safeMode` and `minerals0` come from room objects; the requested `statName` key (e.g. `energyHarvested8`) holds the ranking for that stat. OpenScreeps fills the ranking as an array sorted by value descending; backend-local never fills it; the official client types it as a single `{user, value}` object.

own.description: Controller owner (`level` = RCL), reserver (`level: 0`), or an invader core with level > 0 (`user` omitted on OpenScreeps when the core has no user).

hardSign.description: System sign, typed by the official client only.

safeMode.description: Present when the controller's safe mode ends after the current game time.

name.description: Optional spawn name; the spawn is unnamed when omitted. Non-string values are treated as absent on OpenScreeps.

shard.description: Official shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations; OpenScreeps is single-world and ignores it.

GamePlaceSpawnResponse.description: OpenScreeps and backend-local return `{ok: 1, newbie: true}`; the official client leaves the success body untyped.

GamePublicUser.description: Public projection of a user (`{_id, username, badge}`); fields absent on the user document are omitted.

GamePublicUsers.description: Public users keyed by user id.

shard.description: Official shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations; OpenScreeps is single-world and ignores it.

_id.description: Id of an invader summoned by the caller.

shard.description: Official shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations; OpenScreeps is single-world and ignores it.

GameRoomDecoration.description: Active decoration instance in a room (official inventory system). The official client types it as a `DecorationInstance`.

active.description: Selected property values of the active decoration; `null` when inactive.

GameRoomObject.description: Raw room object document (`rooms.objects`). Only the base fields are stable across object types; every other field is type-specific (see the OpenScreeps engine `RoomObject` state shape) and is passed through as stored.

type.description: Object type tag, e.g. `creep`, `spawn`, `controller`, `source`, `constructionSite`, `ruin`, or a resource type for dropped resources.

user.description: Owner user id; NPCs use `2` (Invader) and `3` (Source Keeper).

GameRoomObjectsResponse.description: Typed by the official client: every room object of the room plus the public profiles of referenced users.

owner.description: Controller owner, or `null` when the room has no owned controller.

stats.description: Graph points per room stat, oldest first, summed over all players in the room (OpenScreeps). backend-local returns `{}`.

statsMax.description: Largest point per `<stat><interval>` key, at least 1 on OpenScreeps; `{}` on backend-local.

totals.description: Window total per room stat (OpenScreeps reports every stat including zeros; the official client documents zero totals as omitted).

GameRoomStatInterval.description: Statistic interval in minutes. Graphs contain 8 points for 8 and 180 minutes and 7 points for 1440 minutes (OpenScreeps `INTERVAL_POINTS`).

GameRoomStatName.description: Per-room, per-user statistic recorded by the engine (`ROOM_STAT_NAMES`).

GameRoomStatus.description: Upstream `_.pick(room, ['status','novice','respawnArea','openTime'])`. Fields absent on the room document are omitted; an unknown room yields `{}`.

status.description: Room status, e.g. `normal`, `out of borders` (backend/OpenScreeps documents) or `closed`/`novice`/`respawn` per the official client.

novice.description: UNIX time in milliseconds until which the room is a novice area.

respawnArea.description: UNIX time in milliseconds until which the room is a respawn area.

openTime.description: UNIX time in milliseconds at which the room opens.

_id.description: Document id; OpenScreeps uses the room name.

terrain.description: 2500 digits indexed by `y * 50 + x`; each digit is a bit mask: 0 plain, 1 wall (`TERRAIN_MASK_WALL`), 2 swamp (`TERRAIN_MASK_SWAMP`), 3 wall.

GameRoomTerrainEncodedResponse.description: Response when `encoded` is non-empty (and, on backend-local, whenever the room's terrain is not a single `terrain` document).

GameRoomTerrainTilesResponse.description: Response when `encoded` is absent or empty: every wall and swamp tile, row by row.

rooms.description: Room names; unknown rooms and non-string items are skipped.
One encoded terrain document per known requested room (OpenScreeps deduplicates repeated names).

enabled.description: Coerced with `!!`; omitted means `false`. The official client defaults to `true`.

shard.description: Official shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations; OpenScreeps is single-world and ignores it.

lastTicks.description: Durations of recent ticks in milliseconds.

shard.description: Official shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations; OpenScreeps is single-world and ignores it.

endTime.description: Point end as `ceil(time / interval)` in interval units (not a tick or timestamp).

GameTerrainTile.description: One non-plain tile; plain tiles are omitted.

tick.description: Shortest of the last 30 measured tick durations in milliseconds. OpenScreeps falls back to the configured tick duration before two ticks were observed; backend-local omits the field until then (`_.min([])` is `undefined`).

height.description: World height in rooms (always equal to width on backend-local/OpenScreeps: `calcWorldSize` returns one square size).

anyOf.description: OpenScreeps/backend-local: every order (active or not) owned by the caller.

shards.description: Orders keyed by shard name; intershard orders under `intershard`.

anyOf.description: Official shape as implied by the official client (`mapToShard` only synthesizes `shards` when absent, and documents intershard orders under the `intershard` key).

MarketOrder.description: Market order document. `price` is converted from stored thousandths to credits; OpenScreeps drops processing-only `_`-prefixed fields except `_id`. The official client types public orders without `_id`/`user`/`active`.

createdTimestamp.description: UNIX time in milliseconds of creation.

user.description: Owner user id (null for NPC orders).

roomName.description: Absent for intershard (account resource) orders on OpenScreeps.

MarketOrderIndexEntry.description: Active-order summary of one resource type.

stdeevPrice.description: Official client typing only (spelling as typed).

MarketStatsEntry.description: Daily price history of one resource (`market.stats`).

PowerCreep.description: Power creep account record (`users.power_creeps`). While spawned, `/list` merges the creep's room object over it (adding `type: powerCreep`, `room`, `x`, `y`, `hits`, `ticksToLive`, `actionLog`, …).

spawnCooldownTime.description: `null` while spawned; otherwise the UNIX time (ms) before which it cannot spawn (0 when never spawned).

deleteTime.description: UNIX time (ms) at which a scheduled deletion completes.

shard.description: Shard the creep is spawned on.

powers.description: Power levels keyed by power id (`PWR_*` constant 1..19).

className.description: Value of `POWER_CLASS`; anything else yields `invalid class`.

name.description: Stored as `String(name).substring(0, 50)`: any JSON value is converted (an omitted name becomes the literal `undefined`).

PowerCreepCreateResponse.description: OpenScreeps returns `{ok: 1, ...creep}` (copy of the new record, `level: 0`, `hitsMax: 1000`, `storeCapacity: 100`, `spawnCooldownTime: 0`, `powers: {}`); backend-local returns its storage insert result for the same record.

id.description: Power creep id owned by the caller.

cooldownTime.description: Game tick until which the power is on cooldown (set by the engine).

name.description: Stored as `String(name).substring(0, 50)`; any JSON value is converted.

powers.description: Complete requested level per power id (missing powers count as level 0, so omitting a learned power is a downgrade and is refused). Only powers of the creep's class, levels 0..5; the sum is the new creep level (max 25). OpenScreeps additionally rejects non-integer levels.
